meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 先向你提几个问题弄清需求,然后动手修改 NanoClaw:增删消息渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件)、改触发规则、接外部服务、调整人设,改完再告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加消息渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件),或改触发词、加集成、调整路由时触发;它会先反问你几个问题再动手。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加成一个输入渠道
say.note: 会先问接入哪个 agent 组、隔离级别等问题

say.text: 给某个 agent 组加上 Gmail 工具
把 Slack 渠道接到现有的 agent 组
say.note: 会创建 messaging group 并接线

howto.what_en: Asks clarifying questions, then adds/adjusts channels (Telegram, Slack, email), changes triggers, wires external services, or edits persona. Then tells how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email), change triggers, add integrations, or modify routing. Any NanoClaw customization request engages it.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: Asks which agent group and isolation level first

say_en.text: Give an agent group a Gmail tool
say_en.note: Runs /add-gmail-tool and wires the MCP server

say_en.text: Connect Slack to an existing agent group
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group and wires it
